name: shatter-the-brittle-destroy-draw-memory
notes: Shatter the Brittle (tdz5of8zuz): "Activate this card only if you control a Fatestone or Fatebound object. Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 1 or less, or with reserve cost 5 or less. If you do, its controller draws a card into their memory." The activation prereq is cardActivatedPrereqs["tdz5of8zuz:0"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) requiring CountFatestoneOrFateboundObjects($player) > 0. As with Expel the Departed, the resolution dispatch key is reassigned by Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (loaded after GeneratedMacroCode.php, so its version is live) to route the destroy through AllyDestroyed() instead of the generated file's own dead raw-move copy. A single Craggy Fatestone (ITEM, FATESTONE, reserve cost 4) does double duty: it satisfies the activation prereq and is the destroy target (its reserve cost 4 <= 5 qualifies it). Verified live: the Craggy Fatestone is destroyed to the graveyard and this player's memory zone grows by exactly one card. Break/restore verified against GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: commenting out AllyDestroyed()/DrawIntoMemory() makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: Activate this card only if you control a Fatestone or Fatebound object.
Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 1 or less, or with reserve cost 5 or less. If you do, its controller draws a card into their memory.
